0022600206.text: The Toronto Raptors host the Memphis Grizzlies in the Raptors' 10th game of the season. Toronto is 5-4 on a one-game win streak, 4th in the Atlantic and 3 games back, and 6th in the East, while Memphis is 6-3 but has lost three straight, sitting 3rd in the Southwest and 1.5 games back and 7th in the West. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Collin Murray-Boyles (illness), Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not played each other yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
